<a id="architecture"></a>

## Architecture

Discovery already supports hidden files (`DiscoverySettings.include_hidden` → `.hidden(!include_hidden)` on the walker). The gap is plumbing: the setting is built once from the global config at two call sites (roots.rs:178 scan/re-add; watch.rs:275 watcher rescan). This packet adds one persisted boolean per root (worktrees table), carries it from the CLI flag through the /roots body into RootReport and the store, and makes both call sites compute `include_hidden = config.scan.include_hidden || worktree.include_hidden`. The skip ledger gains a `hidden` reason so a default add explains itself. No change to the content-addressed skip, parser versions, embeddings or search.

<a id="risks"></a>

## Risks

| id | text |
| --- | --- |
| risk-1 | the watcher builds its settings once per worktree at startup — a flag flipped by re-add must reach the running watcher (re-read per rescan or restart the watcher for that root) |
| risk-2 | hidden directories bring large trees (.venv, .cache) — the deny list must still prune them under include_hidden; assert node_modules/.venv stay skipped |
| risk-3 | migration 0024 on prod runs at the next bounce; keep it a single nullable-free ALTER with a default so it is instant |
